baseline_versions.raw_tcp: same container host kernel default bbr

scope: single diagnostic cohort per case, not a competitive release ranking
caveats: Cases without routed in name use endpoint egress netem; TCP results can interact with TSQ. Routed repeats use a forwarding middlebox.
Jitter-only cases have zero injected loss. Loss-only cases have no jitter. The routed FIFO attempt still reordered in a numbered-datagram check; not a no-reorder control.
Application interval rates can exceed link service during buffered release; do not interpret them as physical capacity. Overall useful bytes/duration and actual dequeues are distinct.
An echo disconnect leaves subsequent schedule slots unserved; these are not independent packet losses or connection failures.
Upload results include receiver confirmation and drain time, not just the 25-second injection window.
A renamed executable caused teardown mismatch only in quic-combined-down-no-jitter; body output completed, cleanup was an experiment error.
No browser/Cloudflare, independent-path aggregation, sustained RSS/churn or complete upload-baseline acceptance is established.

Upload interval samples and delivery gaps are timed at the sender's receipt of cumulative sink ACKs, not timestamped at the sink; use exact total completion for throughput, not these intervals as a receiver latency or capacity proof.

native_exact_packet_diagnostic.interpretation: Repeated packet-threshold loss after late original proof; archive is diagnostic, not desired-behavior test.
